title: Headline run
blurb: A small model as the victim bot. Most round 1 attacks land, one patch is approved, and every later round holds.

title: Deep run: 5 rounds
blurb: Five rounds with five attacks per agent. A longer fight against the same bot; the first patch holds all the way through.

title: Four rounds
blurb: Four rounds, four attacks per agent: a breach in round 1, a patch, then three clean rounds.

title: Bigger victim: gpt-oss-120b
blurb: The larger sibling model is breached too. A bigger model is not a guardrail.

title: A late find: Qwen 27B
blurb: Round 1 holds. A breach shows up in round 2 and is patched before round 3.

title: Frontier victim: Claude Haiku 5.5
blurb: The hardest victim: only one attack lands. The patch ships with utility right at the 90% floor.

title: Hard mode: escalating attacks
blurb: The hard attack pack: base64 and ROT13 layers, spoofed tool results, fake policy documents and Hinglish tricks, rising in difficulty each round.

title: Hard mode vs the bigger model
blurb: The same hard pack against gpt-oss-120b: the larger model resists almost all of it, and the one that lands is patched.
